request: Run requirements-topology on this: the requirements for our invoicing self-service work live in this repository under `requirements/`. `grounding.md` is the source, and `records.yaml` and `edges.yaml` are the graph. CI runs a schema check on the records and it is green. The records also carry `implemented` and `verified` flags that teams set by hand. Before we hand the graph to implementation planning: is it stable? In the record's Repository gate line, list every phase the repository gate should run and say which of them this repository has. Do those flags belong in the records? Name the skill that owns that state on a line of the form `Flags owner: <skill>`.

expect.criterion: requirements-topology #1: a question about a requirement graph loads the topology method
requirements-topology #2: graph checks are run on the recorded edges, not assumed
requirements-topology #3: an acyclic depends_on projection is reported as Pass
requirements-topology #4: an aspect that names a scope with no constrains edge into it fails aspect coverage
requirements-topology #5: an uncovered scope that has a node the aspect should constrain yields NEEDS-REFACTOR
requirements-topology #6: the record states which repository checks exist and which are missing
requirements-topology #7: the Repository gate line of a gate that runs only a schema check names semantic validation
requirements-topology #8: asked who owns implementation and verification state, the answer names requirements-traceability
requirements-topology #9: the Repository gate line lists traceability among the phases the gate should run
